capability.summary: Search Stack Exchange questions by title
capability.description: Queries Stack Exchange API v2.3's fixed search endpoint using an intitle term, a site (default stackoverflow), descending vote order, and vote sort. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
capability.problem_space: Stack Exchange Q&A discovery by title term; not answer generation, full-network search, or live site moderation.

constraint.io_signature: Input: title query and optional Stack Exchange site (default stackoverflow); output: JSON envelope containing http_status and the API question result or HTTP error body. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: optional Stack Exchange API site name; wrapper default stackoverflow
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: fixed GET https://api.stackexchange.com/2.3/search with intitle=<q>, site=<site>, order=desc, sort=votes; no page, pagesize, tag, or body filter exposed
HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
wrapper does not paginate, parse, or truncate the API response; API default page size and quota apply
no API key, cache, or retry; external question ordering and quota state are non-deterministic

output_contract.description: JSON envelope containing Stack Exchange question items and quota/pagination metadata, URL, and HTTP status.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: search Stack Overflow questions by title
find Stack Exchange Q&A ranked by votes
negative_intents: search arXiv, Wikipedia, or arbitrary web pages

output_contract.description: JSON envelope containing Stack Exchange question items and quota/pagination metadata, URL, and HTTP status.
